verdict.rationale: Zero documents AI features that generate insights from mailbox data: composing emails with AI assistance, answering questions about mailbox content and specific threads, and summarizing/chatting with inbox content, corroborated by founder description of AI-powered summarization and chat-with-inbox in community coverage. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of insight quality/accuracy and no broader third-party review confirming these AI features work reliably in practice.
